questions.question: Before recreational sea fishing, what should you do with an adult?
options: Make sure you have the correct permit and permission
Go fishing first and check later
Use someone else’s permit without asking
Fish anywhere if you only keep one fish
questions.answer: Make sure you have the correct permit and permission
questions.explanation: Recreational fishing requires the correct permit. An adult can help check which permit and permissions apply.

questions.question: Why should an adult check the current fishing rules before a trip?
options: Different fish and places can have different limits and seasons
The rules only apply to boats
Every fish has the same size limit
There are no rules when fishing from the shore
questions.answer: Different fish and places can have different limits and seasons
questions.explanation: Rules can include which fish may be caught, minimum sizes, daily limits, closed seasons and restricted areas. Check the current official rules with an adult.

questions.question: You see a sign saying fishing is not allowed here. What should you do?
options: Follow the sign and fish somewhere permitted
Move the sign out of the way
Fish there if you release the fish
questions.answer: Follow the sign and fish somewhere permitted
questions.explanation: Some areas are protected or closed to fishing. Follow signs and check area rules with an adult.

questions.question: An adult finds that a fish is below the legal size. What should happen?
options: Return it to the water as the rules say
Keep it because it is a good catch
Give it to another person to keep
Hide it in the bait box
questions.answer: Return it to the water as the rules say
questions.explanation: Minimum sizes help protect fish. Follow the current rules and an adult’s instructions for releasing a fish safely.

questions.question: Can you sell fish caught on a recreational fishing permit?
options: No, recreational catch may not be sold
Yes, if you sell only one
Yes, if a friend sells it for you
Only if the fish is small
questions.answer: No, recreational catch may not be sold
questions.explanation: Fish caught under a recreational fishing permit are for personal use and may not be sold.

questions.question: Someone is already fishing nearby. What should you do?
options: Find a spot with plenty of space
questions.answer: Find a spot with plenty of space
questions.explanation: Give other fishers room and keep lines from crossing.

questions.question: Before you cast, what should you check?
options: Behind you for people, pets and trees
Only whether your bait is shiny
questions.answer: Behind you for people, pets and trees
questions.explanation: Look all around before swinging your rod.

questions.question: How should you act near other fishers?
options: Use a quiet voice and walk carefully
questions.answer: Use a quiet voice and walk carefully
questions.explanation: Quiet voices and gentle footsteps are considerate and avoid disturbing fish.

questions.question: What should you do with hooks when you are not using them?
questions.explanation: Keep sharp hooks and tackle organised so nobody steps on them.

questions.question: What should you do with loose line and wrappers?
options: Pack them out and use a bin
Leave them for the next person
questions.answer: Pack them out and use a bin
questions.explanation: Loose line can trap birds and other wildlife. Leave the place clean.

questions.question: You are releasing a fish. What is a gentle way to handle it?
options: Wet your hands and keep it in the water
Hold it tightly with dry hands
Keep it out of water for a long time
questions.answer: Wet your hands and keep it in the water
questions.explanation: Wet hands and gentle handling help protect the fish. Follow an adult’s instructions.

questions.question: Birds or swimmers are near your casting spot. What should you do?
options: Ask them to watch for your hook
questions.explanation: Keep hooks, bait and lines well away from people and wildlife.

questions.question: People are using the boat ramp. What should you do?
options: Leave your gear across the ramp
questions.explanation: Be patient and give people room to load and unload.

questions.question: You are paddling past people who are fishing. What should you do?
options: Paddle close and make big waves
questions.explanation: Move slowly and leave plenty of space around other fishers.
